name: 44124 · Lyndhurst, OH
findings: ZIP 44124 (Lyndhurst) has 258 nonprofit organizations. 85 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44124 (Lyndhurst) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
